name: Also Capital
identity_check: Confirmed as Also Capital (alsocapital.com; site operated by Also Capital Management LLC per its terms), the hard-tech early-stage firm founded and run by Managing Partner Mike Annunziata (ex-Farther Farms co-founder, Varda Space board member); Varda CEO Will Bruey is named on the site as a co-founder. Its own blog, Also Blog Posts (alsoblogposts.com, linked from the site), announces the $21M first fund (2024-10-17) and the $50M second fund (2026-02-24), matching the leads. The LinkedIn company page (website alsocapital.com) gives New York, NY, and a 2024 blog post places the team in a SoHo NYC office. The homepage lists Tandem (Seed) as 'Neutral context layer capturing intent from hardware design decisions', and tandem.inc/company lists Also Capital among its backers, so this is the investor in our direct competitor Tandem. Not ALSO Holding (Swiss IT distributor), not the micromobility company called Also, and not any 'Also Ventures'-style namesake; no other firm uses alsocapital.com.

open_items: Tandem (direct competitor): Also Capital appears on tandem.inc/company and Tandem is on Also's homepage (current stage 'Seed'), but no page says which Tandem round Also joined, when, or for how much; one search found no press. Recorded as an undisclosed round. Tandem's seed ($4.9M) was led by Foundation Capital per tandem.json.

No founder application URL: the homepage 'Get in Touch' button is a mailto link to a general inbox (not recorded). ClickUp forms on the blog are for scout / analyst / chief-of-staff hiring, not founders. Cold inbound inferred from the homepage invitation, AndrenaM's founders having 'cold emailed us', and the analyst's podcast on 'what makes a great cold email'.
Nothing found on investing in Indian founders. requires_us_entity: not stated; the stated mission is American hard-tech leadership, and Atlas Motion runs volume production in the Philippines.

Check size for the $50M Fund II is not published; the $1M cap dates from Dec 2024 (Fund I). The homepage now says each fund backs 'roughly 15 formation-stage companies'; the Atlas post says 'We lead ~10 Formation-stage investments per fund.'

SEC EDGAR refused the 'CapitalAtlas research' User-Agent (undeclared automated tool), so Form D filings (fund legal names, exact final-close dates and amounts) were not checked. Fund II close date is the TBPN announcement day (2026-02-23), the day before the blog post. A $100K 'AC Summer Scout Fund' pool runs each summer; not recorded as a fund.

LinkedIn gives founded 2018; the homepage says investing since 2019; the firm went full-time in Sept 2023 (master plan). Mike Annunziata's personal LinkedIn is not linked from the firm's pages (site icons are '#' placeholders), so it is null.
Atlas Motion: Also's post doesn't name the lead (Also kept in 'unspecified'); the Forbes article it links returned 403.

Mesh Optical: Also's post announces its investment on the day of the $50M Thrive-led raise and says it backed Mesh 'since day one', but not which round it joined (kept in 'unspecified'). Surprise: the homepage now marks Mesh Optical 'Acquired'; acquirer and date not found.

Earlier checks not described round by round: AndrenaM initial investment 'last summer' (2024); Northwood 'initial investment ... in 2023' (seed announced 2024-02-20). AnySignal seed press release (Business Wire 2023-10-16, everythingrf) returned 403.

Portfolio companies with no page naming Also in a round: Sea12 (NYC, AI back-office automation for heavy industry; $25M Series A led by Caffeinated Capital per The SaaS News, Also not named; possible adjacent competitor to Utopian Autonomy), Observed Matter (X-ray inspection for high-stakes manufacturing), River Technologies, 4D Surgical, Möbius Industries, Nexa Labs, Polyphron, Neion, Conductor, ShipIn Systems, Fluidstack, K2 Space, Radiant, Varda, Float Health, plus 12 stealth companies (one described as 'Physical backbone for the manufacturing operating system'). Search budget ran out.
Founded year not stated for Atlas Motion, Mesh Optical, Vital Lyfe (SiliconANGLE says co-founded 'last year', i.e. likely 2024) or AndrenaM; AndrenaM and Integral HQ not stated.

Partner focus_sectors are classified from bios (model); the firm does not assign coverage. Venture Partners are operators at portfolio companies, not investing partners; Brandes Woodall (Analyst) states no sector focus.
